id: 09_Industrial Laser Safety Tips for Non-Laser Operators (and Tourists) Innovative L
title: 非激光操作人员与参观者的工业激光安全提示
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/09_Industrial Laser Safety Tips for Non-Laser Operators (and Tourists) Innovative L.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/09_Industrial Laser Safety Tips for Non-Laser Operators (and Tourists) Innovative L/src.py

points.K6: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
points.K7: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停

points.K17: 背面是维修人员的地方
points.K18: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
points.K20: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光车间门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a laser workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 不开激光的人，进车间要注意什么？
overlay: 非激光操作人员与参观者的工业激光安全提示

shots.scene: 储罐、地垫、急停、总闸、灭火器、链条六个图标
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: a cryogenic tank, a floor safety mat, an emergency stop button, a wall disconnect switch, an extinguisher and a chain. No people.
shots.narration: 跟老李把车间完整走一圈。

shots.scene: 办公区门口，老李对镜头讲话，几位访客在旁
shots.prompt_en: At an office door with a blank welcome sign, the facility engineer talks to the camera while a few visitors wait.
shots.narration: 老李经常带客户参观激光车间。

shots.scene: 访客们踮脚往车间里张望
shots.prompt_en: The visitors stand on tiptoe peering toward the workshop door.
shots.narration: 今天，他把要注意的事一样样讲出来。

shots.scene: 访客们指着远处的激光切割机，满脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: Visitors point curiously at a laser cutting machine in the distance.
shots.narration: 客户来了，都想看看激光。

shots.scene: 老李走在访客身旁，伸手示意他们跟紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks beside the visitors and gestures for them to stay close.
shots.narration: 带他们进车间，就得照看好他们。

shots.scene: 老李脚上的钢头工作鞋特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the facility engineer's steel-toed work boots.
shots.narration: 我们自己进车间，穿钢头鞋，

shots.scene: 长裤和安全眼镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of long pants and safety glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 穿长裤，戴安全眼镜。

shots.scene: 激光图标旁加一个扫帚图标，中间画等号连到盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A laser icon and a broom icon joined by an equals sign to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 整理整顿，同样是安全。

shots.scene: 干净的通道，软管电缆挂在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A freshly swept workshop aisle, with hoses and cables hanging on wall hooks. No people.
shots.narration: 通道扫干净，软管电缆离开地面。

shots.scene: 家和办公室的图标，旁边一个车间图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home and an office next to an icon of an industrial workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 访客习惯家里办公室，不熟悉车间。

shots.scene: 老李推门进车间，门内是不锈钢低温储罐
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes open the door; inside stand stainless steel cryogenic tanks with blank labels.
shots.narration: 进门先看辅助气体。

shots.scene: 压缩空气、液氮、液氧三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: compressed air, liquid nitrogen and liquid oxygen. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩空气，或者液氮、液氧。

shots.scene: 温度计图标旁写着零下400度
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with the mercury at the very bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 老李说，低温液体低于零下400度。

shots.scene: 热量箭头传入罐内，压力表指针上升
shots.prompt_en: Heat arrows flow into the tank and a pressure gauge needle slowly rises. No people.
shots.narration: 吸了热，罐里就不断升压。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部的安全阀冒出细细的气流
shots.prompt_en: A thin stream of gas hisses out of a relief valve on top of a tank. No people.
shots.narration: 安全阀会嘶嘶排气，有时突然起跳。

shots.scene: 罐顶阀门附近一圈白霜和水珠
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of white frost and water droplets around the valves on top of an oxygen tank. No people.
shots.narration: 罐顶开始结霜凝露，就是预兆。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部喷出一大团白雾
shots.prompt_en: A big white vapor cloud suddenly bursts from the top of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 排放时喷出白雾，没准备的人会受惊。

shots.section_title: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
shots.scene: 访客站在储罐旁的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor standing right beside a tank, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 觉得它快要起跳，别让访客站旁边。
overlay: 快排放时，别让人站旁边

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 大型激光切割机前，地上铺着黑色安全地垫
shots.prompt_en: In front of a large laser cutting machine, a black safety mat covers the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 人人都想凑到激光机前看。
overlay: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 老李踩上地垫，机器立刻停下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer steps onto the black mat and the whole machine stops at once.
shots.narration: 可只要一踩上这块地垫，

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 地垫图标连到整台机器停止的图标
shots.prompt_en: A floor mat icon linked by an arrow to a whole machine with a stop symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 整台机器马上停止。

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 盾牌图标护着一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protecting a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这是保护人员的重要装置。

shots.scene: 老李在操作台前指着两个按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at two buttons on the operator console.
shots.narration: 停机有两种：急停和进给保持。

shots.scene: 机器末端也有一组同样的按钮
shots.prompt_en: The same pair of buttons at the far end of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 操作台有，机器末端也有。

shots.scene: 切割头运动的箭头被暂停符号挡住
shots.prompt_en: A moving cutting head arrow blocked by a pause symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 进给保持是快停，只中断机器运动。

shots.scene: 一个大红色急停按钮被按下
shots.prompt_en: A large red emergency stop button being pressed. No people.
shots.narration: 急停就不一样了。

shots.scene: 驱动、高压图标一起熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Icons for motor drives and high voltage all switch off together. No people.
shots.narration: 驱动、高压，全部断开。

shots.scene: 老李穿过储罐、冷水机和高大的电源柜之间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks between tanks, a chiller and a tall laser power supply cabinet.
shots.narration: 再往里走，是总隔离开关。

shots.scene: 老李指着墙上的闸刀开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at a large knife disconnect switch on the wall.
shots.narration: 出了事故、新人不知所措时，

shots.scene: 闸刀拉下，激光器、冷水机、辅助设备图标一起熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The knife switch is pulled down and icons of the laser, the chiller and support equipment all go dark. No people.
shots.narration: 拉下这个开关，全部一起断电。

shots.scene: 老李做一个果断拉闸的手势
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer makes a firm pulling-down gesture.
shots.narration: 要是还得想一想，就直接拉闸。

shots.scene: 工作台边摞着废料桶，尖角从桶口伸出
shots.prompt_en: At the end of a workbench, scrap bins are stacked with sharp metal pieces sticking out. No people.
shots.narration: 废料桶图方便放在通道边，

shots.scene: 一个边走边张望的人图标，腿碰到伸出的尖角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person looking around while walking, whose leg hits a sharp corner sticking out. No people.
shots.narration: 伸出的尖角会扎伤东张西望的人。

shots.scene: 折弯机和激光机上方画着声音波纹，人的视线都朝上
shots.prompt_en: A press brake and a laser machine with sound wave lines, and eye icons all looking up at them. No people.
shots.narration: 大家都在看会响的折弯机和激光机。

shots.scene: 畅通的通道和挂起的线缆打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clear aisle and cables hung off the floor, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 所以通道要清，线缆要离地。

shots.scene: 人靠在激光机上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning against a laser machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要靠在激光机上。

shots.scene: 手搭在格栅条上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand resting on the jagged grid slats, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手别搭在格栅支撑条上。

shots.scene: 有人爬上切割台的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person climbing onto the laser cutting bed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 更不要爬上切割台。

shots.scene: 一个缝针的医疗图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple medical stitches icon with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 曾有人摔在上面，缝了几十针。

shots.scene: 老李按下上料台侧面的按钮，万向球一齐升起
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses a button on a loading table and all the transfer balls rise with a loud sound.
shots.narration: 上料台的万向球气动升起，

shots.scene: 一位访客背对着台面，听到响声吓了一跳
shots.prompt_en: A visitor with his back to the table jumps in surprise at the sound.
shots.narration: 突然一响，背对着的人会吓一跳。

shots.scene: 蓝色废料架，大块废料竖放，链条挂住
shots.prompt_en: A blue scrap rack with large sheet skeletons standing upright, held by a heavy chain. No people.
shots.narration: 废料管理很容易失控。

shots.scene: 老李拉起大链条锁住废料
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls a heavy chain across the rack and latches it.
shots.narration: 废料架用大链条锁住。

shots.scene: 架子上方伸出一截板角，正好在头部高度
shots.prompt_en: A sheet metal corner sticks out from the top of the rack at head height. No people.
shots.narration: 伸到头部高度的板角，切掉或收好。

shots.scene: 红色二氧化碳灭火器和黄色D类灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A red carbon dioxide extinguisher on the wall and a yellow metal fire extinguisher on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 车间配了D类和二氧化碳灭火器。

shots.scene: 白色粉末喷满电路板，旁边空白账单加一千美元
shots.prompt_en: White powder covers circuit boards, next to a blank repair bill with a stack of dollar coins. No people.
shots.narration: 精密电子设备用干粉，修理多一千美元。

shots.scene: 粉末遇水汽，电路板出现锈斑
shots.prompt_en: Powder meets water vapor droplets and rust spots spread on the circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉残留会腐蚀，毁掉一切。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳罩住火焰，气体散去后电路板干净
shots.prompt_en: Carbon dioxide gas covers a flame, then drifts away leaving a clean circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳排开氧气，挥发不留东西。

shots.scene: 电闪图标连到二氧化碳灭火器打勾
shots.prompt_en: An electrical bolt icon with a flame, linked to a carbon dioxide extinguisher with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 电气火灾，用二氧化碳。

shots.scene: 钛和合金块图标旁的黄色灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Icons of titanium and alloy blocks next to the yellow extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: D类用于钛这类会燃烧的金属。

shots.section_title: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦
shots.scene: 老李绕到激光机背面，黄黑链条拦在通道口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks around to the back of the laser machine, where a yellow and black chain blocks the walkway.
shots.narration: 绕到机器背面看看。
overlay: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦

shots.section_title: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦
shots.scene: 背面地面没有安全地垫的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the machine's back side: no floor safety mat there. No people.
shots.narration: 这里没有安全地垫。

shots.section_title: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦
shots.scene: 链条像拉绳一样拉开拦住通道
shots.prompt_en: The chain is stretched across the walkway like a safety cord. No people.
shots.narration: 所以用链条拦住，防止有人被缠住。

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 维修人员图标拿着工具站在背面
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a maintenance technician with tools at the back of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 背面通常只有维修人员进来。
overlay: 背面是维修人员的地方

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 光路反射镜座和校准工具
shots.prompt_en: A beam path mirror mount with an alignment tool next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 在这里做光路校准等工作。

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 光路护罩上贴着黄色激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A yellow laser warning sign stuck on a beam path cover. No people.
shots.narration: 看这张黄色警示贴。
overlay: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 示意图：激光在柜内产生，经几面反射镜转向，送到切割头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the laser beam is generated in a cabinet, bounces off a series of mirrors and is sent down to the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 激光在柜里产生，经一组反射镜，

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 光束在镜子间整形、转向的动画
shots.prompt_en: Animation of the beam being shaped and turned between mirrors on its way to the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 整形、转向，送到切割头。

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 护罩揭开，后面有一条光路
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the cover is lifted and a beam path is right behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 揭开护罩，后面就可能有激光束。

shots.scene: 看不见的光束示意：一条虚线和一只闭着的眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an invisible beam drawn as a dotted line, next to a closed eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这是红外激光，眼睛看不见。

shots.scene: 开着激光揭开护罩的图标，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cover lifted while the laser is on, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 开着激光揭开护罩，光射出你也不知道。

shots.scene: 虚线光束落在纸箱上冒起火苗
shots.prompt_en: The dotted beam line lands on a cardboard box far away and a flame starts. No people.
shots.narration: 它最后打到哪儿，就可能在哪儿起火。

shots.scene: 维修人员图标旁一本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: A maintenance technician icon next to a blank procedure book. No people.
shots.narration: 维修人员必须懂得规范作业。

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 龙门架带着风琴管在导轨上来回移动
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the gantry slides back and forth on its rail, carrying the folding bellows with it. No people.
shots.narration: 链条还防机械伤害。

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 老李沿背面走，指着导轨和风琴管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks along the back and points at the rail and the bellows.
shots.narration: 切割时，整个龙门架在导轨上来回滑。

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 背面的检修面板
shots.prompt_en: Service panels on the back of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 检修面板，需要时才进来。

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 老李拉起链条挂好
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the chain and hooks it across the walkway.
shots.narration: 链条挂着，就是不得进入的警示。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现鞋子、储罐、地垫、急停、总闸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of boots, a cryogenic tank, a safety mat, an emergency stop and a disconnect switch.
shots.narration: 穿好鞋裤眼镜，储罐快排别站旁边。

shots.scene: 地垫、急停、总闸三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a floor mat, an emergency stop button and a knife switch. No people.
shots.narration: 地垫一踩就停，急停全断，拿不准就拉闸。

shots.scene: 通道、格栅、废料架、灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clear aisle, grid slats, a chained scrap rack and two extinguishers. No people.
shots.narration: 通道清，不靠不爬，电气火用二氧化碳。

shots.scene: 链条和黄色警示贴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chain across a walkway and a yellow laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 背面有链条，红外光看不见。

shots.scene: 欣欣和访客们在车间门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the visitors at the workshop entrance.
shots.narration: 激光车间走一圈，下次见！
